title: More control and clearer file details
notes: Undo common file operations such as trashing, moving, renaming, and copying when you need to reverse a change.
Customize your workspace with additional panes, see free and total space for drives, and spot hidden files more easily.
Plugin developers get an embedded debugging console and activation callbacks, while GoTo history can now stay private for the current session.
Status messages are now tied to the relevant pane and no longer prevent the window from becoming narrower.
